summary: K5 (K5 KILLED): on a CORRECTED node-centred discretisation of the Gordon-Webb-Wolpert pair (connected, non-congruent, full-spectrum isospectral to 1e-14, lambda_1 within 2.5e-03 of Betcke-Trefethen), nets trained only on strike-and-listen recordings -- never shown the domain, the strike/listen nodes, or the eigenvalues -- separate the two drums. Restricted to the SHARED interior (so the domain mask cannot be the cue) and with strike/listen nodes held out, the waveform CNN reaches 0.5675 (p=1.5e-04) and the modal-power arm 0.8912 (p=4.7e-123). A classifier on the eigenvalue tower sits at 0.4875 (chance) and the amplitude-stripped control at 0.5038, so the signal is carried entirely by the modal amplitudes phi_n(s) phi_n(p) -- eigenfunction information leaking through a scalar projection. Projections are NOT spectrum-limited. The pre-registered STRENGTH gates D2 (0.80) and D3 (0.75) are a separate question from the postulate; see D2/D3 fields. NOTE for the bridge: the cell-centred scheme in k2_drums.py disconnects each drum into three pieces that are congruent piece-by-piece, and an explicit permutation P gives max|L2[P,P]-L1| = 0 exactly, so the two discrete operators are the SAME matrix relabelled; K2's 1e-15 agreement there is trivial rather than transplantation, and K5 is untestable on it (no observable can distinguish them).
